claims: As of April 13, 2026, the Indiana Fever have built a 2026 roster around cornerstones Caitlin Clark, Aliyah Boston, and Kelsey Mitchell.
Kelsey Mitchell signed a supermax extension.
The Indiana Fever has added veterans including Sophie Cunningham, Lexie Hull, Damiris Dantas, and Myisha Hines-Allen.
The Indiana Fever has added 2026 draft picks Raven Johnson (No. 10) and Justine Pissott.

The guards on the 2026 Indiana Fever roster as of April 13, 2026 are Caitlin Clark, Kelsey Mitchell, Sophie Cunningham, Lexie Hull, Ty Harris, Raven Johnson, Megan McConnell (Training Camp), and Kayana Traylor (Training Camp).
The forwards/centers on the 2026 Indiana Fever roster as of April 13, 2026 are Aliyah Boston, Damiris Dantas, Myisha Hines-Allen, Makayla Timpson, and Monique Billings.
The Indiana Fever's key re-signings/additions include Kelsey Mitchell (Supermax), Sophie Cunningham, Lexie Hull, Myisha Hines-Allen, Damiris Dantas.
The Indiana Fever's 2026 draft class includes Raven Johnson (No. 10), Justine Pissott (No. 25), and Jessica Timmons (No. 40).
Head coach Stephanie White highlighted the addition of guard Raven Johnson to the backcourt.
